name: Promptable Explicit Scene Representation
definition: A mechanism to enable 3D editing (extraction, deletion, appearance modification) by computing activation scores of 3D Gaussians based on prompts (text, points, boxes) using cosine similarity and softmax.
summary: Promptable Explicit Scene Representation enables 3D editing in Gaussian Splatting by computing activation scores for explicit Gaussian primitives, distinguishing itself from implicit NeRFs through direct manipulation of color and opacity.
